status: User-approved trial profile; not final balance or integrated gameplay
scope: Isolated opening trial; do not silently retune entire existing level.
authority: Canonical trial overrides over existing entity definitions; Engineering bundle loader applies explicitly for trial mode only.

runner.behavior: Existing Flushfiend patrol/aggro/turnaround; no new acceleration changes.

shooter.status: Initial role tuning; Art/Level defines identity
shooter.aim: Lock player position at windup start; one non-homing projectile per shot, no offscreen fire. Clear line of sight required; cancel unsafe shot if global budget full.
shooter.timing: First shot no earlier than0.8s visible; windup included in1.8s start-to-start interval.

emerger.status: Initial role tuning; Art/Level defines identity
emerger.behavior: Premarked fixed floor vent. Harmless before fully emerged+settled; then mindless horizontal floor patrol/contact threat. No jumping or chasing; turn at patrol bounds and blocking solids.
emerger.spawn_safety: Reject occupied landing marker or route with no reachable escape. Recheck before becoming damaging; hold/reselect if player remains on marker, never turn damage on underneath hero.

flyer.status: Repeating dive/rise/top-pause/retarget source revision; integrated build pending
flyer.path: Fly forward until visible hero is within400px on either side; lock target during0.65s warning, dive0.8s, rise forward to original altitude over1s, pause stationary1s, then face hero and repeat. Within6px of horizontal center retain previous facing. Blocked diagonal recovery climbs vertically with swept collision.
flyer.retirement: Activated living Widow does not retire offscreen; remains a repeating threat until killed or attempt reset. Entry warnings may still cancel safely.
flyer.balance_rationale: 15 Tony12-damage hits or10 Sean18-damage hits;2.24/2.16 seconds first-to-last firing plus travel and misses.

swarm.placement: Not included in12-enemy opening roster; retain non-hunting behavior if tested separately.

schedule_rules: 12 authored entities total,8runners/1shooter/1emerger/2flyers.20s is target not forced deadline. Respect placement triggers and safety budgets; delay pending entries and drop missed timing rather than dump backlog. On reaching trial end allow completion without mandatory kills of escaped flyers.
budget_rules: One shooter in initial schedule is below cap3, intentionally. Reserve slot before telegraph, release on death/retire. Do not delete visible bullets to satisfy cap; defer firing with no burst backlog. Projectile threat includes all visible hostile shots, not cosmetics.
damage_rules: One player contact-hit unit; respect global invulnerability and spawn protection, never stack hits same tick. Keep true projectile/sprite collision alignment.
boss: No boss fight tuning in opening slice. Later first-level finale requires one visible Clogfather; never concurrent background duplicate.720current vs1080candidate unresolved; do not apply proposed boss HP automatically.

validation.timing: Record input sampling, successful shot timestamps and impact timestamps. Immediate first eligible shot within one physics tick; sustained intervals quantized to physics tick within one tick tolerance, not animation duration. Test while idle, running, aiming, jumping and after action-release guards.
validation.miss_recovery: After a deliberate miss, next eligible shot within configured0.16/0.24s plus one physics tick. Separate travel time from input/cooldown latency.
other: Verify generated trial bundle explicitly selected; normal profile unaffected.
Range caps remain320/480 logical pixels in every direction.
Grounded down diagonals and continuous leg animations preserved.
No offscreen shots, emitter teleport damage or unsafe floor activation.
Fixed seeds, both heroes, misses and alternative routes; record deaths/clear time, not just perfect-hit bots.
Budget counters include warmups/entry markers and decrement after cleanup.
No fake kill credit for retired flyers.

delivery: Engineering owns runtime integration/build/roadmap and reports actual trial version; this JSON is a ready mechanics data handoff. Role timings are implementer-selected first-pass tuning, not separately user-selected numbers.
